newsitem.title: MEXICO: Transportacion Ferroviaria places $400 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Transportacion Ferroviaria places $400 mln bonds.

text.p: Transportacion Ferroviaria Mexicana (TFM), a joint venture between Mexico's Transportacion Maritima Mexicana SA (TMM) and Kansas City Southern Industries Inc, successfully placed two bonds worth $400 million, TMM said on Wednesday.
"It was a private placement and the issues were oversubscribed," Pedro Sanchez Mejorada, head of investor relations at TMM, told Reuters.
The money would be used to pay part of the more than $800 million still owed to the Mexican government for the company's recent purchase of Mexico's Northeast Railway, he said.
